results.evidence: `canShowAlternatives` no longer requires `editMode`: `!!featureFlags[...CHART_ALTERNATIVES] && isSupportedSurface && isTrends && !!query && !!trendsSource`, with `isSupportedSurface = !embedded && !inSharedMode && !isInDashboardContext`. `options` and `alternatives` are unchanged, so view mode gets the same options. I did not see the component, but it presumably branches on this selector.

The old fallback to the `ChartFilter` dropdown was driven by `canShowAlternatives` being false, which was true whenever `editMode` was false. That gate is removed, so in view mode the gallery is chosen instead of the dropdown. The component is not shown, but the summary says it switches on this selector.

`options`, `alternatives`, the `galleryOpen` reducers and the `selectChart` listener are untouched. Permission and disabled-reason checks moved from `canShowAlternatives` to `canSelectCharts`, so an editable user in edit mode gets the same result as before.

The `selectChart` listener only requires `canSelectCharts`, a trends source, a valid option and a changed display. `canSelectCharts` no longer depends on `editMode`, so it is true in view mode. The listener then calls `updateQuerySource({ trendsFilter, breakdownFilter })`, the same path as edit mode.

Embedded, shared and dashboard-tile surfaces are still excluded by `isSupportedSurface`. The `canEditInsight` check was removed from the gate, so users without edit permission are no longer excluded. The author confirms that a viewer without edit permission "still sees the gallery trigger, disabled". `canSelectCharts` only adds `!editingDisabledReason`, so the gallery is shown disabled rather than hidden.
`canShowAlternatives` still requires the `PRODUCT_ANALYTICS_CHART_ALTERNATIVES` flag, `isTrends`, `!!query` and `!!trendsSource`. Only the `editMode` and permission terms were removed.

The `galleryOpen` reducer and the `openGallery`, `closeGallery` and `toggleGallery` actions do not depend on `editMode`. `openGallery` only closes the gallery if `!values.canSelectCharts`, which is true in view mode for editors. The component is not shown, but the same gallery component and logic serve both modes.

result:
The chart type gallery now shows in view mode as well as edit mode, in place of the dropdown. I haven't run the tests or typecheck, so none of this is verified.

The gate was in `products/product_analytics/frontend/insights/chartAlternatives/chartAlternativesLogic.ts`. The gallery only appeared when `editMode` was true, because an `isEditableSurface` selector required it. Otherwise `ChartAlternatives` fell back to the plain `ChartFilter` dropdown.

- **Gate:** I replaced `isEditableSurface` with `isSupportedSurface`. It now drops the `editMode` requirement and keeps the existing exclusions for embedded, shared and dashboard-tile contexts. `canShowAlternatives` uses it.
- **Permissions:** a viewer without edit permission still sees the gallery trigger, disabled with the reason. `canSelectCharts` now checks `editingDisabledReason`, the same reason the old dropdown used.
- **Cleanup:** I removed the now-unused `canEditInsight` connection and updated the typegen-style interfaces by hand.
- **Feature flag:** the gallery still depends on the `PRODUCT_ANALYTICS_CHART_ALTERNATIVES` feature flag and on trends insights. With the flag off, or on other insight types, the dropdown remains.
- **Test:** I added a test in `ChartAlternatives.test.tsx` that renders with `editMode={false}` and checks the gallery trigger appears.
- **Edit mode:** edit-mode behaviour is unchanged.

If you'd rather people who can't edit keep the plain dropdown instead of a disabled gallery button, that's a small change to the same gate.
